messages:
Maria (Sales): Hey team — GreenTrust Bank (POC) just asked for our SOC 2 artifacts, ISO scoping doc, and a signed pen-test acceptance letter. They also asked whether Dedicated capacity pricing differs for POC vs committed. Need to respond today.

Ajay (SE): I can put together a short POC package. For the POC we usually provide redacted SOC2 system description + control matrix, audit report summary (redacted), and the ISO scoping statement. For pricing, Dedicated POC is typically quoted as time-boxed reserved capacity with a short-term discount — I’ll draft numbers.

Katie (Security): Quick note on artifacts: we can share the SOC 2 Type II report redacted (no vendor-only sections), the control narratives, and our latest penetration test summary (non-sensitive findings). We do NOT share raw logs or internal config. For ISO, we can provide the Statement of Applicability (SOA) high-level export and the scope diagram.

Tom (Legal): Pen-test acceptance letter — we have a templated letter that states scope and that Redwood accepts the test results if certain rules are followed (no destructive testing, coordinate with oncall). I need the customer name and the external vendor details to sign. Also confirm whether they require us to be the signatory or the third-party tester.

Maria (Sales): They gave vendor name: SecureProbe Ltd, PoC window dates 2026-04-20 to 2026-04-24. They asked for a signed letter by EOD Thurs.

Dave (CSM): For the POC access: we need to provision a dedicated sandbox instance (short-lived) and add GreenTrust's engineers as collaborators. Ajay — can you confirm the infra steps and IAM roles?

Ajay (SE): Yes — I’ll spin up a dedicated pool under the trial tenant, create a scoped API key, and a role with read/write for model inferencing only. I’ll also enable request-level logging to the audit S3 path: s3://redwood-poc-logs/greentrust/2026-04. Share only aggregated logs for compliance.

Katie (Security): Two asks from my side before we sign pen-test letter: 1) confirm IP allowlist window for the tester, 2) a statement from the customer that they’ve authorized SecureProbe. If SecureProbe is external, we require a non-disclosure acknowledgement.

Maria (Sales): I’ll ask the customer for the authorization email and tester IP ranges. Tom — can you prep the templated letter so we can sign once we have those?

Tom (Legal): On it. I’ll prepare the letter and add the standard non-destructive clause and coordination instructions. Will tag it as: `PT-letter-GreenTrust-1898765432.docx`. Need Security sign-off before signature.

Katie (Security): Review timeline: I can review the letter tomorrow morning and approve if conditions met. Also: we need to mark the SOC2 docs as redacted and watermark them per policy. Who will do watermarking?

Dave (CSM): I can watermark and upload to Box. Please drop the final SOC2 PDF in "/team/sales/soc2-share/greentrust/" and I’ll set link expiry to 14 days.

Ajay (SE): Pricing note: For short-term Dedicated POC we usually offer 30% off list for up to 2 weeks of reserved capacity. If they convert to Reserved Capacity contract within 30 days, apply trial credit of one week. I’ll send a short quote snippet in the thread.

Maria (Sales): Perfect. Action items: 
- Maria: request SecureProbe authorization email + IP ranges from GreenTrust (today).
- Tom: draft pen-test letter (ready EOD tomorrow).
- Katie: security review & watermark rule check (tomorrow AM).
- Ajay: prepare POC infra + draft pricing (ETA 24h).
- Dave: prepare Box folder and link policy.

AuditBot: Automated reminder — Compliance artifacts access must be logged. Please ensure S3 ACLs and Box share are restricted to the participant list.

Maria (Sales): Thanks all — I’ll update once I have the authorization email. :thumbsup:

Ajay (SE): FYI, one technical caveat: if they request full KV-cache persistence/long sequences for load testing we should recommend Dedicated with higher memory config. Will call that out in the quote. :eyes:

Tom (Legal): If they ask for contract amendment (pen-test results liability), escalate to contracts. For now standard acceptance letter is fine.

Katie (Security): Once I get the tester IPs I’ll whitelist and confirm maintenance window.

Dave (CSM): Stand by for Box link. Maria — ping me when SOC2 file is uploaded and I’ll handle expiry/watermark.

Maria (Sales): Uploaded the authorization from GreenTrust and the tester IPs into the thread. Link: https://secure.box.com/greentrust-auth — please check.

Katie (Security): Got it, reviewing auth now.

Tom (Legal): Drafted the pen-test letter and uploaded at: https://redwood-internal/drive/PT-letter-GreenTrust-1898765432.docx — open for security review.

Ajay (SE): POC infra ready in dev: API key `poc-greentrust-2026`, pool `dedicated-poc-gt-1`. Sent SSH/IPs to whitelist.

Maria (Sales): Customer confirmed they’ll sign NDA with SecureProbe. GreenTrust also asked for estimated cost for a 2-week Dedicated POC vs hosted burst. I’ll prepare a short comparison table.

Dave (CSM): Closing loop: once pen-test letter signed and IPs whitelisted, we can start the POC. ETA: 48 hours after signature.

Maria (Sales): Great team — thanks. I’ll close this thread when all artifacts are shared and letter signed.
